nvitk.gui.viz.view_capture
==========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.viz.view_capture

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Export Napari viewer screenshots (3D canvas, 4D GIF).

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: _dims_slot_for_array_axis(viewer: Any, array_axis: int) -> int

   Map array-axis index to Napari dims slot (for GIF export only).


.. py:function:: _array_axis_for_dims_slot(viewer: Any, dims_slot: int) -> int

   Inverse of :func:`_dims_slot_for_array_axis`: map a Napari dims slot back to an array axis.


.. py:class:: GifAnimationSpec

   Time axis and frame count for viewer GIF export.


   .. py:attribute:: time_axis
      :type:  int


   .. py:attribute:: dims_slot
      :type:  int


   .. py:attribute:: n_frames
      :type:  int


   .. py:attribute:: phase_layer
      :type:  Any | None
      :value: None



.. py:class:: _ViewerViewState

   Snapshot of a Napari viewer's dims/camera state, for save-and-restore around screenshot/GIF export.


   .. py:attribute:: ndisplay
      :type:  int


   .. py:attribute:: order
      :type:  tuple[int, Ellipsis]


   .. py:attribute:: point
      :type:  tuple[float, Ellipsis]


   .. py:attribute:: current_step
      :type:  tuple[int, Ellipsis]


   .. py:attribute:: axis_labels
      :type:  tuple | None


   .. py:attribute:: camera_center
      :type:  tuple | None


   .. py:attribute:: camera_zoom
      :type:  float | None


   .. py:attribute:: camera_angles
      :type:  tuple | None


.. py:function:: _process_events() -> None

   Flush pending Qt events so the viewer redraws before a screenshot is captured.


.. py:function:: _capture_viewer_state(viewer: Any) -> _ViewerViewState

   Snapshot *viewer*'s current dims/camera state into a :class:`_ViewerViewState`.


.. py:function:: _restore_viewer_state(viewer: Any, state: _ViewerViewState) -> None

   Restore *viewer*'s dims/camera to a previously captured *state*.


.. py:function:: time_axis_index(viewer: Any, layer: Any) -> int | None

   Return the array axis used for the time/cardiac slider, or None.


.. py:function:: _gif_spec(viewer: Any, *, array_time_axis: int, n_frames: int, phase_layer: Any | None) -> GifAnimationSpec

   Build a :class:`GifAnimationSpec` from an array-space time axis, resolving its Napari dims slot.


.. py:function:: _frame_count_for_array_time_axis(viewer: Any, array_time_axis: int, *, phase_layer: Any | None = None) -> int

   Number of frames along *array_time_axis*, preferring *phase_layer*'s own time axis length when
   given, else the viewer dims range for that axis.


.. py:function:: resolve_gif_animation(viewer: Any, layer: Any | None = None, *, time_axis: int | None = None) -> GifAnimationSpec

   Find how to step the Napari dims slider for GIF export.

   Supports 4D image layers and synced 4D flow-vector overlays (3D vectors layer).


.. py:function:: _paused_flow_dims_sync(viewer: Any) -> Iterator[None]

   Disconnect live flow dims hook while GIF frames are written (avoids re-entrancy).


.. py:function:: _set_dim_slot_index(viewer: Any, dims_slot: int, index: int) -> None

   Set time on the Napari dims slot that maps to the cardiac axis (4D image GIFs).


.. py:function:: _set_gif_frame(viewer: Any, spec: GifAnimationSpec, frame: int) -> None

   Advance to cardiac phase *frame* for one GIF screenshot.

   Flow overlays: step Napari's cardiac dims slot (volume/MIP) and set vector glyphs
   from the precomputed cache by index (do not use the live dims callback here).


.. py:function:: _ensure_3d_view(viewer: Any) -> None

   Switch *viewer* to 3D display mode if it isn't already, then flush pending Qt events.


.. py:function:: export_view_png(viewer: Any, path: str | pathlib.Path, *, canvas_only: bool = True, flash: bool = False) -> numpy.ndarray

   Capture the current Napari 3D canvas to a PNG.

   Temporarily enables ``ndisplay=3`` if needed, then restores the prior view.


.. py:function:: export_view_gif(viewer: Any, path: str | pathlib.Path, *, fps: float = 8.0, time_axis: int | None = None, canvas_only: bool = True, layer: Any | None = None) -> int

   Export one 3D screenshot per time point as an animated GIF.

   Returns the number of frames written.
